limitations: Matched rectangular flat torus only; intrinsic normalized area pair sampling; fixed positive L and H for endpoint asymptotics; arbitrary curved metrics and arbitrary same-area tori are not covered.
scientific_integrity: The claimed strict comparison and endpoint asymptotics are proved analytically for the explicit flat quotients; numerical checks are corroborative and not a general proof. The comparison is a new mathematical statement relative to the identified squared-moment calculation, not a claim of exclusive worldwide historical priority.
title: Strict stochastic distance dominance and cubic diameter tails on rectangular flat Klein bottles
